rule.name: AWS EC2 Startup Script Modified on Stopped Instance
rule.description:
A successful EC2 StopInstances request was followed within one hour by a successful ModifyInstanceAttribute request targeting userData on the same instance, by the same IAM principal.
This may indicate an attempt to change instance startup behavior or establish persistence.
These CloudTrail events do not confirm that the modified user-data script executed.
rule.query:
`cloudtrail`
eventSource="ec2.amazonaws.com"
eventName IN ("StopInstances", "ModifyInstanceAttribute")

| eval user_arn='userIdentity.arn'

| eval instance_id=case(
    eventName="StopInstances", 'requestParameters.instancesSet.items{}.instanceId',
    eventName="ModifyInstanceAttribute", 'requestParameters.instanceId'
  )

| mvexpand instance_id

| where isnotnull(eventID) AND isnotnull(instance_id) AND isnotnull(user_arn)
    AND (isnull(errorCode) OR errorCode="" OR lower(errorCode)="success")

| where eventName="StopInstances"
    OR (eventName="ModifyInstanceAttribute" AND 'requestParameters.attribute'="userData")

| dedup eventID instance_id

| eval event_epoch=coalesce(strptime(eventTime, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), _time)

| sort 0 user_arn instance_id awsRegion event_epoch

| streamstats current=f
    last(eval(if(eventName="StopInstances", event_epoch, null()))) AS stop_epoch
    last(eval(if(eventName="StopInstances", eventID, null()))) AS stop_event_id
    BY user_arn instance_id awsRegion

| where eventName="ModifyInstanceAttribute" AND isnotnull(stop_epoch)

| eval elapsed_seconds=event_epoch-stop_epoch

| where elapsed_seconds>0 AND elapsed_seconds<=3600

| eval stop_time_utc=strftime(stop_epoch, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

| eval modification_time_utc=strftime(event_epoch, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

| rename eventID AS modification_event_id

| table user_arn instance_id awsRegion stop_time_utc modification_time_utc
        elapsed_seconds stop_event_id modification_event_id

| `aws_ec2_startup_script_modified_on_stopped_instance_filter`
false_positives:
Authorized administrators and infrastructure automation may stop instances and update their user data.
Review the IAM principal, instance, change window, and approved automation before escalating.
